data.body: Closeout handoff: updated the plan to require independent exact-candidate review before the first Gerrit push, added rtk-prefixed focused checks plus lint and type checking, and delegated the full suite to Gerrit Verified. The refreshed plan review returned signed PASS with LLM coverage and one nonblocking P6 advisory. The canonical worktree environment is provisioned at /Users/joeoakhart/comment-remediation-a0f1-20260910-a using isolated uv 0.12.7. The branch remains clean at its base. The ticket remains open and unclaimed because the session entered closeout before implementation began.
